verdict.rationale: Fivetran's documented capability is exclusively source-to-warehouse/lake ELT (connectors, transformations, destinations) with no product feature for pushing modeled warehouse data back into SaaS tools like CRM/ads/support. Community evidence (fivetran-comm-20) explicitly contrasts Fivetran as an 'APIs to database' (ingestion) tool versus reverse-ETL tools like Census, confirming the direction described in this story is not something Fivetran delivers.
